pages.text: 早上，阳光从窗帘缝里照进来，落在咘咘粉色的裙子上。她一边刷牙一边想着今天的好事：猪猪姐姐要来玩，还可以吃冰淇淋，晚上还可以看冰雪奇缘。想着想着，她的心里就出了大太阳，暖暖的，像被太阳抱了一下。
pages.text_en: In the morning, sunlight came through the curtains and fell on Bubu's pink dress. While brushing her teeth, she thought about today's good things: Zhuzhu would come to play, there would be ice cream, and Frozen in the evening. Thinking about them, a big sun rose in her heart, warm, like a hug from the sun.

pages.text: 咘咘在客厅里蹦蹦跳跳，裙子转成了一朵花，心砰砰跳得很快。妈妈蹲下来，笑着对她说：“你看，高兴的时候，身体会跳起来，脸会笑，心会跳得快快的，连脚都想跳舞呢。”
pages.text_en: Bubu jumped up and down in the living room, her skirt spinning like a flower, her heart beating fast. Mummy crouched down and smiled. "Look, when you are happy, your body jumps, your face smiles, and your heart beats so fast that even your feet want to dance."

pages.text: 下午，咘咘搭了一座高高的积木塔，可是塔晃了一下，哗啦一声全倒了，积木滚得到处都是。咘咘愣住了，胸口紧紧的，脸热热的，手也紧紧握着。妈妈说：“你看，生气的时候，身体会变紧，脸会变热，手会握成小拳头。”
pages.text_en: In the afternoon, Bubu built a tall block tower, but it wobbled and crashed down with a clatter, blocks rolling everywhere. Bubu froze. Her chest felt tight, her face felt hot, and her hands clenched. Mummy said, "Look, when you are angry, your body gets tight, your face gets hot, and your hands curl into little fists."

pages.text: 晚上，天上打了一个响雷，雨点啪啪地打在窗户上。咘咘一下子缩到妈妈身边，小手抖抖的，紧紧抓住妈妈的裙子。妈妈轻轻抱住她说：“你看，害怕的时候，身体会缩起来，手会抖，还特别想找大人抱抱。”
pages.text_en: At night, thunder rumbled and raindrops pattered on the window. Bubu shrank beside Mummy at once, her little hands shaking, holding Mummy's skirt tightly. Mummy hugged her gently. "Look, when you are scared, your body shrinks, your hands shake, and you especially want a grown-up hug."

pages.text: NOMI 拿来一张天气卡片，举到咘咘面前。卡片上有太阳、云朵、小雨和暴雨，都画得圆圆的。NOMI 指着卡片说：“你看，情绪就像天气。有晴天，有阴天，也会有小雨和暴雨。每一种天气都会来，也都会走。”
pages.text_en: NOMI brought a big card with weather pictures and held it up in front of Bubu. On the card were the sun, clouds, light rain and a rainstorm, each drawn round and cute. NOMI pointed at the card. "Look, feelings are like weather. There are sunny days, cloudy days, light rain and rainstorms. Every weather comes, and every weather goes."

pages.text: 咘咘伸出小手指着卡片，认真地说：“早上我是晴天，下午我是暴雨，晚上我是小雨。一天里，我的心里可以有好几种天气呢！”她说着说着，自己都笑了，原来一天有这么多天气，一点也不奇怪。
pages.text_en: Bubu pointed at the card with her little finger and said seriously, "In the morning I was sunny, in the afternoon I was a rainstorm, and at night I was light rain. In one day, my heart can have many kinds of weather!" As she spoke, she laughed herself. It was not strange at all to have so many weathers in one day.

pages.text: 妈妈抱着咘咘，温柔地说：“情绪没有好坏。生气、高兴、害怕，都是真的，都是可以说的。你把心里的话说出来，爸爸妈妈才能听见你，才能陪你一起想办法，而不是让你一个人憋着。”
pages.text_en: Mummy held Bubu and said gently, "Feelings are not good or bad. Angry, happy, scared — they are all real, and they can all be said. When you say what is in your heart, Mummy and Daddy can hear you and think of a way together with you, instead of leaving you to hold it in alone."

pages.text: NOMI 掰着手指，教咘咘四个工具：“第一，暂停一下，按一下手掌。第二，闻花吹蜡烛，慢慢呼吸。第三，把话说出来，告诉别人你怎么了。第四，请大人帮忙，也不丢人。”咘咘跟着 NOMI 数，点点头记住了。
pages.text_en: NOMI counted on her fingers and taught Bubu four little tools: "First, pause, press your own palm. Second, smell a flower and blow out a candle, breathing slowly. Third, say the words out loud and tell others how you feel. Fourth, ask a grown-up for help. That is nothing to be ashamed of." Bubu counted along with NOMI, nodding as she remembered each one.

pages.text: NONO 拍着翅膀飞过来，大声说：“哭也是可以的！”Coco 也笑着说：“Crying is okay！哭是可以的！”咘咘听了点点头，眼泪慢慢干了。她明白了，哭不是坏事，哭完了，心里反而会轻松一点。
pages.text_en: NONO flapped his wings and flew over, calling out, "Crying is okay too!" Coco smiled and said, "Crying is okay!" Bubu nodded as she listened, and her tears slowly dried. She understood now: crying is not a bad thing. After crying, her heart felt a little lighter.

pages.text: 妈妈说：“情绪过后，还可以修复：道歉、抱一下、一起收拾、再试一次。就像雨停了，太阳又出来了，心里也会慢慢晴起来。”咘咘抱了抱妈妈，觉得心里真的亮了一点，像云被风吹开了一样。
pages.text_en: Mummy said, "After a feeling, you can also repair: say sorry, hug, tidy up together, and try again. Just like after the rain stops and the sun comes out again, your heart slowly clears up too." Bubu hugged Mummy and felt her heart brighten a little, as if the wind had blown the clouds away.

pages.text: 晚上，咘咘裹着小毯子靠在妈妈身边，把今天的事一件一件讲给妈妈听：早上的晴天、下午的暴雨、晚上的小雨，还有她给每一种天气起的名字。妈妈亲了亲她的额头说：“你做得真好，今天的天气，你都认出来了。”
pages.text_en: At night, wrapped in a little blanket and leaning against Mummy, Bubu told her about today, one thing after another: the morning sunshine, the afternoon rainstorm, the night light rain, and the names she gave each weather. Mummy kissed her forehead. "You did so well. You recognised all of today's weather."

pages.text: 窗外，天气还在慢慢变化，云一会儿聚，一会儿散。咘咘知道，天气还会变，情绪还会来。没关系，下一次，她可以先说出它的名字，再用小工具慢慢等一等，等心里晴起来。
pages.text_en: Outside the window, the weather was still slowly changing, clouds gathering and scattering by turns. Bubu knew the weather would change again, and feelings would come again. That was okay. Next time, she could name the feeling first, then use her little tools and wait slowly until her heart cleared.
